```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library("phyloseq")
library("ggplot2")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("patchwork")
library("readr")
library("tidyverse")
library("grid")
library("gridExtra")
library("paletteer")
library("forcats")
library(viridis)
library(hrbrthemes)
```





```{r, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# upload the metadata
df <- read_csv("D:/Users/hayde/Documents/R_sites/honey_diversity/data/metadata_miel.csv")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# rename the names of the samples
# change n_specie to specie_n
df <- df %>%
  mutate(SampleID = case_when(
    grepl("_Scapto", ID) ~ paste0("Scapto_", sub("_Scapto.*", "", ID)),
    grepl("_Melli", ID) ~ paste0("Meli_", sub("_Melli.*", "", ID)),
    TRUE ~ as.character(ID) 
  ))
rownames(df) <- df$ID
df$ID <- factor(df$ID, levels = unique(df$ID))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(1),ID , fill= pH)) + 
  geom_tile(color = "white",width = 1, height = 1)+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrBr")+
  #scale_fill_viridis(discrete=FALSE, option = "C", , direction = -1) +
  #scale_fill_thermal(name = "pH") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Samples")+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12), 
         legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'), 
         axis.title = element_text(size = 16), 
         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16), 
         plot.title = element_text(size = 20), 
         axis.title.x = element_blank(),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
         legend.title = element_text(size = 16))+
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
```

```{r}
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pH, Moisture, Conductivity, Ash, HMF, Total_sugar, Colorimetry), # Añadir las otras columnas aquí
               names_to = "Parameter",
               values_to = "Value")

# Graficar boxplot con jitter para todas las columnas en un solo gráfico
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Specie, y = Value, fill = Specie)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(color="black", size=1, alpha=0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#b8860b", "#FFBF00")) +  # Personalizar colores para las especies
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free_y") +  # Facetas para cada variable
  theme_ipsum() +
  theme_light()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 16), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16), 
        #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face="italic", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16), 
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16))+
  xlab("")

```
